extra: Main board of the Petlibro PLWF116 cordless water fountain (board revision DVT2), RTL8721DM with external 8 MiB XTX flash (JEDEC 0B 40 17).

The flash layout keeps the vendor bootloaders, which hard-code OTA1 at 0x6000 and OTA2 at 0x186000. The app size is capped at 0xFA000 because OTA1 ends where the SDK settings sectors (UART/AP settings, BT FTL, fast reconnect) begin at 0x100000; OTA2 keeps its full 0x180000 slot.
vendor_cfg holds the vendor's cloud identity, device settings and calibration data; vendor_log holds the vendor's event log. Neither is touched by LibreTiny.
The GPIO list is a superset for pin discovery: SPI flash pins PB12-PB17 and the flash power switch PB22 are excluded.
